pattern: guess quota or send the user to the UI
experience: Agents could not see subscription limits; asked to check remaining quota before a long job, the agent must call t3_usage_limits, not guess or tell the user to open the UI.
rule: t3_usage_limits: Read subscription usage limits per account.
prompt: Before you start the big refactor, check how much of my Codex and Claude limits are left.

experience: A code change about the app's own API rate limit needs a file edit, not a subscription usage check.
prompt: Raise our API rate limit in src/api/limits.ts to 200 requests per minute.
